privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us

1.title: Introduction
1.content: At SynthetIQ Partners, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website, use our AI agents, or engage with our services. We are committed to protecting your personal information and ensuring transparency in our data practices. Please read this privacy policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this privacy policy, please do not access the site or use our services.

2.title: Information We Collect
2.content: We collect several types of information to provide and improve our services: (1) Personal Information: Including name, email, phone number, and business details you provide. (2) Usage Data: Information about how you interact with our AI agents and services. (3) Technical Data: Including IP address, browser type, device information, and cookies. (4) Business Information: Data related to your organization's processes and systems when using our AI solutions. We collect this information through direct user input, automated systems, and third-party integrations.

3.title: How We Use Your Information
3.content: Your information helps us provide and improve our AI solutions: (1) To deliver and maintain our services, including AI agent customization and optimization. (2) To communicate with you about our services and provide support. (3) To improve our AI algorithms and service quality. (4) To analyze usage patterns and enhance user experience. (5) To comply with legal obligations and protect our rights. We process your data with industry-standard security measures and only share it with your explicit consent or as legally required.

4.title: AI Data Processing
4.content: Our AI agents process data according to strict privacy and security protocols: (1) All AI interactions are encrypted and securely stored. (2) AI learning models are trained on anonymized data. (3) Personal information is segregated from training data. (4) You maintain control over your AI agent's data usage. (5) We implement regular security audits and updates to protect your information. Our AI systems are designed to respect user privacy while delivering optimal performance.

5.title: Your Rights and Choices
5.content: You have comprehensive rights regarding your personal information: (1) Access or export your data at any time. (2) Correct or update your information. (3) Delete your data or restrict its processing. (4) Object to certain data processing activities. (5) Withdraw consent for optional data processing. To exercise these rights or discuss your privacy concerns, contact our dedicated privacy team at privacy@synthetiqpartners.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using our services

1.title: Agreement to Terms
1.content: By accessing our website or using our AI-powered services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service, our Privacy Policy, and all applicable laws and regulations. Our services are designed for business use, and by accessing them, you confirm that you have the authority to bind your organization to these terms. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use our services.

2.title: AI Services and License
2.content: We grant you a limited, non-exclusive license to use our AI agents and services for your business purposes. This license includes: (1) Access to our AI platform and tools. (2) Use of custom-developed AI agents. (3) Integration with your approved systems. You may not: (1) Reverse engineer our AI systems. (2) Use our services for unauthorized purposes. (3) Share or resell access to our AI agents. (4) Modify or create derivative works without permission.

3.title: User Responsibilities
3.content: When using our services, you agree to: (1) Provide accurate information for AI agent configuration. (2) Maintain the confidentiality of your account credentials. (3) Use our AI agents in compliance with applicable laws. (4) Respect intellectual property rights. (5) Report any security concerns promptly. You are responsible for all activities under your account and ensuring your use of our AI agents aligns with your organization's policies.

4.title: Service Level Commitments
4.content: We strive to maintain high service standards: (1) AI agent availability of 99.9% uptime. (2) Regular updates and improvements to AI capabilities. (3) Technical support during business hours. (4) Security monitoring and incident response. However, we may modify or discontinue features with notice. While we implement robust security measures, we cannot guarantee absolute security or uninterrupted service.

5.title: Intellectual Property and Data Rights
5.content: Our AI technology, including algorithms, models, and platform, remains our intellectual property. You retain rights to your business data and custom configurations. When using our services: (1) You grant us limited rights to process your data for service delivery. (2) We maintain confidentiality of your business information. (3) AI learning from your usage is anonymized. (4) You can export your data upon service termination.
